Maya (PM): Heads-up — customer A asked for an embeddings endpoint with 512 dims, up to 1000 items per request, and a 50ms median latency SLO for interactive lookups. Can we scope this for Q2? cc @Alex @Priya :eyes:

Alex (Eng Platform): Quick take: 512 dims is fine. Biggest risks are batch size and memory/throughput. 1k per request is heavy on GPU HBM and KV cache. Need model choice + whether they expect synchronous response or async streaming.

Priya (Eng-ML): Model options: "distil-emb-v2" (faster, cheaper, slightly lower quality) or "ada-like-open" (higher quality). With int8 quant we can fit larger batches on 24GB; with fp16 we'd run out sooner. Need to confirm quantized model support in the private stacks.

Dan (Product): 50ms median for 1k sounds unrealistic. Propose we offer two API modes: `interactive` (default max_batch=64, target <=50ms median) and `bulk` (max_batch=1000, target 300-800ms). Customers can pick route per-request with a hint.

Casey (CSE): Customer said their UX does real-time nearest-neighbor on page load; they said initial 100ms is acceptable if steady-state improves. They can tolerate a staged rollout. I can push to negotiate a relaxed SLA.

Alex (Eng Platform): Implementation idea: allow `batch_hint` in request: "priority":"interactive" | "bulk". Route interactive to hot pool (reserved nodes, small batch window), bulk to queued pool (larger batching, background prefetch/caching). Default API still accepts up to 1000 but will respond with 429 or queue when interactive pool is saturated.

Priya (Eng-ML): Response contract should include simple metadata fields so customers can make routing decisions client-side: `model`, `dims`, `quantization`, `processing_ms`. Keep it flat (no nested JSON objects) to avoid parsing inconsistencies across SDKs.

Maya (PM): Launch acceptance criteria I want: (1) perf baseline: interactive median <=50ms on 95% of test queries for up to 64 batch, (2) bulk path handles 1000 batch with median <800ms, (3) quality: cosine recall >=0.88 vs customer baseline, (4) docs + SDK examples, (5) migration guide for >64 batch customers. Can firmware tests and numbers be in by EOW?

Alex (Eng Platform): I'll run perf sweep on prod-like infra tomorrow. Quick repro snippet I'm using:```python
send_batch(batch_size=1000, dims=512, model='distil-emb-v2-int8')
measure_latency()
```

Priya (Eng-ML): I'll queue quality evals comparing distil vs ada-like. Tagging @bench-bot to start scheduled runs and push results to dashboard.

bench-bot: Scheduled run: embeddings/batch/512/1000 on cluster-staging at 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Results will publish to /dash/embeddings/batch-tests when done.

Dan (Product): :thumbsup: Let's plan a short RFC next week with proposed API surface, routing semantics, and SLA tiers. Maya to consolidate customer acceptance tests and commit timeline.

Maya (PM): I'll draft the acceptance test matrix and capture the customer's willingness to accept the two-tier SLA. Also loop in legal for any SLA language. Will share draft RFC by Wed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
